title: Lunch
hook: 爷爷奶奶用自家菜园的蔬菜做午餐，乔治一样都不爱吃，最后却把蔬菜全吃光了。

cells.q: Where did Peppa and George go for lunch?
cells.a: They went to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for lunch.
cells.cn: 他们去爷爷奶奶家吃午饭。

cells.a: It is Grandpa Pig's vegetable garden, and he grew it all.
cells.cn: 这是猪爷爷的菜园，菜都是他自己种的。

cells.q: What did Grandpa Pig ask Peppa?
cells.a: He asked her, “Peppa, do you like tomatoes?”
cells.cn: 他问她：“佩奇，你喜欢西红柿吗？”

cells.q: Which vegetable does George not like?
cells.a: He does not like lettuce, so Granny looks for one he likes.
cells.cn: 他不喜欢生菜，奶奶只好再找别的。

cells.a: She thinks George will like them in a lovely salad.
cells.cn: 她觉得做成沙拉乔治就会喜欢。

cells.a: She made pizza for lunch, with salad to go with it.
cells.cn: 她做了披萨当午餐，还配了沙拉。

cells.q: What did they ask George to try?
cells.a: They asked him to try a little bit of tomato.
cells.cn: 他们让他尝一点点西红柿。

cells.a: He is eating the tomatoes, lettuce and cucumber at last.
cells.cn: 他终于把西红柿、生菜和黄瓜都吃了。

cells.a: Because he is too full to eat any more vegetables.
cells.cn: 因为他太饱了，一点蔬菜也吃不下了。
